propositions: Operators need reproducible measurement of tickets-store footprint separated into packed object bytes, checkout logical/allocated bytes, and Git-directory bytes, without conflating Git packing with checkout residence or filesystem block slack.

Add explicit opt-in read-only `rebar tracker-footprint` command that measures mounted tracker and/or creates temporary single-branch fresh clones without automatic invocation from writes, reconciliation, gates, Gerrit Verify, or metrics.

Fresh-clone measurement must resolve configured remote and branch, create unfiltered temporary clone with hardlink optimization disabled, report measured ref/tip alongside values, and clean up only command-owned temporary state on failure.

JSON and text output must report packed object bytes, checkout logical bytes, checkout allocated bytes with platform `st_blocks` support, file count, allocation slack, Git-directory logical/allocated bytes, and whole-clone totals as structured unavailable when unsupported.

No fixed footprint threshold, shrink-only ratchet, scheduled trigger, CI gate, or workflow automation is introduced; size measurements are descriptive only and never affect exit status or block unrelated work.
